correctness.rationale: Exact regular-representation decomposition yields 10 minus two scalar-zero indicators minus twice the two nontrivial determinant-zero indicators. Mixed blocks cannot be zero matrices. In three-one supports, simultaneous vanishing of all three frequency determinants forces ac=0, contradicting exact support. Parallel pair determinant slopes force either zero/one singular block or all three simultaneous, whereas skew simultaneous nontrivial determinants force L0=5ab != 0. The pure-coset case uses the prime Fourier-minor theorem and explicit inverse-DFT witnesses. Nineteen nonzero coefficient witnesses were symbolically checked; a structurally separate 10x10 regular-matrix program checked all 1040 transported witness instances across all 210 supports. Full proof, assumptions and limitations are in RESULT.md; numerical tests alone are not the exclusion proof.

value.rationale: The complete four-tap rank diagram is a natural nonabelian sparse-convolution classification for the first odd dihedral group with two genuinely different pair-gap geometries. The 50 parallel two-two supports can attain rank 5 but not 7; the 50 skew counterparts can attain 7 but not 5, and the three-one and pure cases complete all 210 supports. Such support-geometry-sensitive attainable ranks go beyond an uncertainty lower bound or a routine evaluation of one weighted kernel, supplying exact recovery-loss possibilities for arbitrary nonzero tap weights.
